title: Overview builds a full-transcript O(N) projection on first paint of long sessions
outcome:
overviewMessages is now the full client-held transcript (was the 20-message tail, which sat below the 30-message gate and built no projection at all). buildEstimatedRows runs estimateConversationMessageHeight per message; for assistant text that is several full-string regex passes (markdown normalize, wrapped-line count, split(/\n\s*\n/), three global countMarkdownPatternMatches, countFencedCodeBlockLines).

Cold cost ~tens of ms for 600 messages; hundreds of ms for a few thousand. Mitigations that do work: the metadataCacheRef WeakMap makes it once-per-message, and useDeferredValue + idle rail activation keep it off the first paint — so this is a regression in TOTAL main-thread work, not input latency. But useDeferredValue renders restart when urgent updates arrive, so under sustained streaming the deferred projection can thrash, compounding with the per-delta getLayoutSnapshot() in the messageCount-conflation bug.

Action: profile with a ~5000-message session. If it bites, bucket/cap the projection input or throttle the rebuild rather than leaning on useDeferredValue alone.
